name: Ghidra 12.1.2
why: shared/ghidra-mcp drives a real headless Ghidra JVM. Without a local install the ~60 live tests (`just test-live-ghidra`) can only be run in CI, which turns every diagnosis into a push-and-wait loop. Set GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR to the install root.
install: Download ghidra_12.1.2_PUBLIC from https://github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra/releases/tag/Ghidra_12.1.2_build, unzip it, and set GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR to the extracted root (the directory containing support/ and ghidraRun).

name: JDK 21
why: Ghidra 12.1.2 declares application.java.min=21; an older JDK fails at JVM start with a message that never mentions the version.

name: clang
why: Builds the live-test fixture program (shared/ghidra-mcp/tests/fixtures/fixture.c) with debug info, so Ghidra's datatype manager sees the named Rect/Color types the read tests assert on.

name: mlc
why: The pre-push hook (lefthook.yml) and `just links` run `mlc --offline --gitignore` to catch broken local markdown links. Without it every push fails at the hook.
install: cargo install mlc — or `just setup`, which binstalls it with the other dev tools.

name: OpenCode source (tag matching the installed `opencode --version`, currently v2.0.32)
why: shared/opencode-ctl drives OpenCode's CLI and HTTP API; every statement in docs/specs/2026-10-18-opencode-ctl-mcp-design.md about OpenCode behaviour is cited as packages/<path>:<line> at that tag. Settle behavioural questions by reading the source (read-only, untrusted: grep and read from outside, never build or run inside it), not by probing the binary. Expected under ~/.cache/aiplugins/opencode-src.
install: mkdir -p ~/.cache/aiplugins/opencode-src && git -C ~/.cache/aiplugins/opencode-src init -q && git -C ~/.cache/aiplugins/opencode-src remote add origin https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode.git && git -C ~/.cache/aiplugins/opencode-src fetch --depth 1 origin tag v$(opencode --version | grep -o '[0-9.]*$') && git -C ~/.cache/aiplugins/opencode-src checkout -q FETCH_HEAD
